theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the headline theme with the second-highest raw score and the strongest combination of trend-gate eligibility, durability (0.84), and breadth (1.0) among eligible names. The detector's one validated leg is drawdown control via the absolute-trend gate, and Big Pharma is the highest-ranked eligible trend with full participation. Crowding (z=1.46) is a size-down caution only, not a fade.
theses.dissent: A crowded defensive theme with rank-IC ~0 on momentum could simply be a late-stage flight-to-safety; if the AI/tech macro narrative reasserts, healthcare leadership is vulnerable to a sharp handoff.

theses.subject: Health Care (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Adjacent confirmation of the healthcare leadership: eligible, trend, durability 0.78, breadth 0.917. The trend-gate leg is the discipline here; equal-weight healthcare is the broadest scorable expression of the same defensive narrative.
theses.dissent: XLV is heavily weighted to the same crowded large-caps as PPH; if the crowded defensive trade unwinds, the equal-weight proxy provides little differentiation.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
